purpose: Trace public Didipio River fish-study leads in Nueva Vizcaya without turning aggregate environmental-report graphics or an inaccessible abstract into species occurrences or food-safety advice.

sources.title: Environmental Performance Report and Management Plan (EPRMP) for the Didipio Gold/Copper Project, submitted for second review
sources.provider: OceanaGold (Philippines), Inc.; hosted by the DENR Environmental Management Bureau
sources.reviewedEvidence: The report's contents list Figure 2-46, 'Taxa richness of fish recorded in the studies conducted from 1997 to 2015,' and Figure 6-102, freshwater ecology sampling stations surveyed for studies conducted from 2012 to 2016. The reviewed searchable text describes aggregate ecological monitoring and Didipio watershed stations but did not expose a fish-by-site species list or the underlying monitoring datasets.
sources.limits: Project EPRMP and monitoring summary, not a Region II inventory; the figure captions do not establish species identities, individual events, or present-day distributions. No item-specific open reuse license was identified.

sources.title: Delicacy or deadly: Is the fish on your table a friend or a foe?
sources.provider: National Research Council of the Philippines e-Gallery; authors listed as Alma Lorelei de Jesus-Abejero, Keshia Tingson-Abucay, Erwin Tabaco, Tomas Reyes Jr., and Nelson Pampolina
sources.reviewedEvidence: The NRCP e-Gallery search index exposes the full abstract although direct page retrieval timed out. It reports fish collection in October 2024 (wet season) and July 2025 (dry season), using broad labels eel (printed as 'Anguilliformers'), rainbowfish (Atheriniformes), tilapia (Cichlidae), and catfish (Siluriformes). It summarizes seven metals and seasonal results, but gives no scientific species names, specimen IDs, station names, coordinates, sample sizes, or underlying concentration table in the indexed abstract.
sources.limits: Abstract-only acquisition lead; publication date, full citation, full text, sample identities, methods, analytical table, and reuse terms remain unverified. Do not use its indexed food-intake, contaminant, or seasonal-harvest recommendations as app safety advice.

nextAction: Seek the source reports and species/sample appendices behind the Didipio EPRMP's 1997-2015 richness figures and the complete NRCP paper or dataset. Require scientific names, collection event dates, site-level provenance, methods, and reuse terms before any occurrence is considered. Continue unrelated Region II site discovery in parallel.
